generate_label_map_ek100: generate a label map and action mapping from EK100 dataset CSV annotation files
generate_label_map_charades: generate a label map and action mapping from CharadesEgo dataset class files
generate_label_map_egtea: generate a label map and action mapping from EGTEA dataset action index files
generate_tokenizer_bert: generate a BERT or DistilBERT tokenizer instance based on the model name string
generate_tokenizer_gpt2: generate a GPT2 variant tokenizer instance based on the model name string
